$comment: Gear at the Academy (owner, 2026-11-07): weapons come in three tiers that show. plain is what creation gives; fine is bought from the yard's smith for Marks; named comes from a Hunt's named beast (the zone's named weapon) or from the Archive for three Salvage fragments. A tier multiplies damage; a named weapon carries a trait. The hero keeps one weapon; a better tier replaces the worse. Traits: bleed (every hit burns), reach (longer), quick (shorter recoveries), heavy (more knockback), field (every hit gives Will).

bleed.name: bleeds
bleed.text: every hit leaves the foe burning a while

quick.name: quick
quick.text: comes back to the guard sooner

heavy.name: heavy
heavy.text: throws the foe back on every hit

field.name: field-bound
field.text: every hit gives a little Will

green.name: Old Grey's Tooth
green.text: cut from the named wolf of the Green; it remembers the bite

shenandoah.name: The Ferryman's Hook
shenandoah.text: taken from the river-thing that ferried the drowned town

harpers-cut.name: The Yard Dog's Jaw
harpers-cut.text: the junction's hound, set in iron

cahokia-river.name: Long Mother's Spine
cahokia-river.text: the eel's spine, quick as the current

archive.name: The Archive's Own
archive.text: made at the Archive from three things carried out of the ruin

lines.default: The smith's bench is open. A fine edge costs Marks; a named one costs a beast.
lines.offer: A fine {weapon}: {cost} Marks. It hits a tenth harder and it shows.
lines.bought: Done. Carry it where it can be seen.
lines.have: Nothing finer than what you carry; bring me a beast's name.
